scenario_source: synced scenario copy of mock_citation_scenarios.json (MC-01..MC-08) plus T-CIT-MISSING

cases.asserts: exact alias resolution yields verified_exact and the envelope's citation_display verbatim in the rendered answer
multiple citations each get independent verification records; one verified_exact does not vouch for others
model-drafted citation text is replaced by envelope citation_display (model text never rendered)
subsection claim supported only by parent chunk clamps to verified_parent and renders the parent citation form
granularity clamp does not silently upgrade: parent envelope cannot render child-level pinpoint
SYNTHETIC prefix on fixture citations survives to the response unaltered
confidence is capped by the weakest citation level: any verified_parent caps confidence below the exact-only ceiling
citation not present in this request's envelopes is unverified and fatal even if another fixture contains it (no out-of-band authority)
drafted answer with zero citations converts to unsupported_answer refusal with GA-1 rule_id

invariants: citation verification records written one per citation on both answer and conversion paths
unsupported_answer conversion leaves no draft fragments in the envelope
